specs.applicability: local endpoint residual has declared operand or schedule strata
specs.intervention: remove stratum-conditioned mean while preserving support, variance and residual norm distribution
specs.sham: matched permutation preserving each stratum marginal
specs.support_criterion: raw local bias and downstream bias are present; mean-removal reduces downstream bias; sham does not
specs.not_applicable: no predeclared strata or no endpoint atomization
specs.unresolved: missing complete vector layer, insufficient states, or failed common-state match

specs.applicability: local residual atoms can be paired with cotangent, Jacobian/VJP, or saved-state transport factors
specs.intervention: permute residual and transport pairing while preserving both multisets, marginals, support and norms
specs.sham: within-orbit permutation that preserves declared semantic pairing
specs.support_criterion: local residual is centered, real pairing yields downstream directional bias, pairing shuffle removes it, sham does not
specs.counterexample_criterion: pairing shuffle does not change downstream bias
specs.unresolved: pairing or transport provenance is incomplete

specs.applicability: forward, saved/recomputed representation and backward reconstruction have a declared numerical contract
specs.intervention: unify the forward/backward numerical contract without changing real-valued semantics or ABI
specs.sham: change an unrelated representation field with matched compute and memory footprint
specs.support_criterion: candidate downstream bias disappears under contract repair and not under sham
specs.counterexample_criterion: contract repair leaves downstream bias unchanged
specs.not_applicable: no saved/reconstructed value or no contract boundary
specs.unresolved: contract repair is not exact, common state is invalid, or a layer is missing
